facts.where is china located?: China is located in East Asia.
facts.where is japan located?: Japan is an island country located in East Asia in the northwest Pacific Ocean.
facts.where philippines located?: The Philippines is located in the western Pacific Ocean.
facts.what is martial law?: Martial law is the suspension of ordinary law and civil liberties by government military control.
facts.what is military junta?: A military junta is an authoritarian form of government led by a committee of military officers.
facts.what is constitutional monarchy?: A constitutional monarchy is a form of government in which a monarch shares power with a constitutionally established government.
facts.what is absolute monarchy?: An absolute monarchy is a form of government where the monarch holds supreme autocratic authority unrestricted by written laws or a constitution.
facts.what is presidential system?: A presidential system is a system of government where the executive branch is led by a head of state elected independently of the legislature.
facts.what is parliamentary system?: A parliamentary system is a system of government where the executive branch derives its democratic legitimacy from and is accountable to the legislature.
facts.what is charter change?: Charter change is a process of amending or revising the constitution of a nation.
